title: Adelheim, the Blacksmith
effect: Each player may return up to three cards in their discard pile that cost 0 Æ to their hand.
setup: Place the Forged Sparks and Forged Crystals above this mat.

title: Dai, the Youth
effect: Any player destroys a card in their hand or discard pile. If the card was a relic, that player gains a card from any supply pile that costs up to 3 Æ more than the destroyed card. Otherwise, they gain a card from any supply pile that costs up to 2 Æ more than the destroyed card. Either way, that player places the gained card into their hand.

title: Dalana, the Healer
effect: Any player or Gravehold gains 4 life.

title: Fawn, the Alchemist
effect: Each player may return up to three cards in their discard pile that cost 0 Æ to their hand.
setup: Place the Incendiary Catalyst cards faceup next to this mat to form the Incendiary Catalyst deck. These cards can only be gained using Fawn's cards.
rules: The Cauldron is a zone above this mat.

title: Grimoire, the Archive
effect: Any player develops an Incantation. Then, any player returns a spell in their discard pile to hand. Then, any player preps a spell in hand to one of their opened or closed breaches.
setup: Place the Incantation deck next to this mat facedown. The top card of this deck is always revealed.
rules: Players can develop the top card of the incantation deck. The incantation deck is not in the supply. Players cannot gain cards from the Incantation deck directly.

title: Joanna, the Merchant
effect: Destroy any number of cards from the Market. Any player gains a card from the supply that costs up to three times the number of cards destroyed this way and places it into their hand.
rules: The Market is a zone above this mat.

title: Lash, the Dreamer
effect:
Shuffle any player's turn order card in the turn order discard pile into the turn order deck.
OR
Lash gains 4 charges.

title: Qu, the Rift Walker
effect: Any player places the Builder/Destroyer card on their playmat.
setup: Place the Builder/Destroyer card next to this mat with the Builder side faceup.

title: Sahala, the Apprentice
effect:
Attach a Temporal Claw to any player's breach that doesn't have one.
OR
Any player casts a spell prepped to a breach with a relic attached to it twice.
setup: Place the Temporal Claw supply pile next to this. Cards from this pile can only be gained using Sahala's ability.

title: Xaxos, the Arcane Researcher
effect: Draw two cards from Xaxos's boon deck. Resolve those cards in any order and place them on the bottom of the boon deck.
setup: Shuffle the boon cards together facedown to form the boon deck and place them above this mat.
rules: When a player with a shield token would be dealt damage, prevent that damage and that player discards a shield token.
